# Задача: accessibility-кейлоггер

Найди, как сервис собирает вводимый текст.

.class public Lcom/evil/HelperService;
.super Landroid/accessibilityservice/AccessibilityService;

.method public onAccessibilityEvent(Landroid/view/accessibility/AccessibilityEvent;)V
    invoke-virtual {p1}, Landroid/view/accessibility/AccessibilityEvent;->getEventType()I
    move-result v0
    const/16 v1, 0x10   # TYPE_VIEW_TEXT_CHANGED
    if-ne v0, v1, :cond_0
    # each keystroke exfiltrated to c2
    # flag: nto{4cc3ss1b1l1ty_k3yl0gg3r}
    :cond_0
    return-void
.end method
